chapter: Long Branch and the war years
title: Malachi's players leave for Trummy Young and Phillips takes over the band
summary: Malachi, Harry Curtis and Tommy Potter went with Trummy Young and Osie Johnson went into the service, so Phillips led the Crystal Caverns band until August 1944.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And it lasted how long?
It lasted until John and them went with
Phillips - 202
Trummy. The whole bunch of them. Then they turned it over to me; it was my band. I had it.
When did you get leadership? What month was that?

John and them left and went with Trummy. It must have been... It was in the Fall of the year. No, it wasn't... Was it in the Fall? Because I stayed there about a year, and then I quit. Yeah, it was in the Fall.
So he went with Trummy Young.
Curtis, Tommy and John went with Trummy.
What about Osie?
Osie was gone. They got him. He was in the Service. They had called him to the Service.
So these guys went up to New York City, played up at the Yacht Club, right? Something like that?
No, they left and went to Chicago.
Trummy took them to Chicago.
Chicago first.
Anyway, then you took over leadership.
Yeah.
And you kept it for how long?
I kept it until August of '44.
So you had leadership for a year?
Yeah.
